blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.store.productOption` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Store API routes.

This method retrieves a paginated list of product options. It sends a request to the
[List Product Options](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#product-options\_getproductoptions) API route.
